capture_authority.record: Task 10A predeployment full-state capture for Person 1705
capture_authority.post_query: SELECT * FROM {posts} WHERE post_type = 'person' ORDER BY ID ASC
capture_authority.postmeta_query: SELECT * FROM {postmeta} WHERE post_id = 1705 ORDER BY meta_id ASC
capture_authority.taxonomy_query: SELECT r.object_id,r.term_taxonomy_id,r.term_order,tt.taxonomy,tt.term_id,t.slug,t.name,tt.parent,tt.count FROM {term_relationships} r JOIN {term_taxonomy} tt ON tt.term_taxonomy_id = r.term_taxonomy_id JOIN {terms} t ON t.term_id = tt.term_id WHERE r.object_id = 1705 ORDER BY r.term_taxonomy_id ASC,r.term_order ASC,tt.taxonomy ASC,tt.term_id ASC,t.slug ASC
